products.description:
Vitamin C, incorporated into the formula with Vitamin E and Lifting Peptide. The formula helps skin looks firmer, more radiant and younger.

Instantly, skin looks bouncier, firmer and more radiant.
Day by day, pore looks tightened, skin feels lifted, apple cheek looks much plumper.

UV city resist in the packset is a sunscreen with patented MEXORYL XL^^for UVA & UVB protection

^^MEXORYL XL UV protection ingredient is patented in France

Enriched with Pro-Xylane PRO^ + B5 + Triple HA
Hydrate + Repair + Anti Aging in One

•Enriched with Pro-Xylane PRO^
﻿A new generation of Pro-Xylane raw material with higher purity^. Formula helps smoothens skin and reduces finelines.

•Panthenol B5
Ingredient known for its conditoning and soothing properties, while helps strengthening epidermal barrier function.

•High purity triple Hyaluronic Acid^^
Well known moisturzing ingredient. Penetrating into the skin for moisturization.


﻿Instantly: skin feels hydrated, soft and soothed.
Day after day: fine lines looks reduced and skin looks firmer & appears younger.

• Every piece of REVITALIFT FILLER [HA]
Fresh Mix Pro-Xylane PRO Mask is filled with 33g of essence

•Juice and tissue seperated, the soft mask tissue has strong absorption power that can carry 21 folds of serum than its own weight* .The alginated mask tissue is soft and comfortable, perfectly fits the contours of the skin.
• Tested under dermatological control, suitable for sensitive skin

^Pro-Xylane refers to raw material [Hydroxypropyl Tetrahydropyrantriol, water, and Propylene glycol] ; Pro-xylane refers to [Hydroxypropyl Tetrahydropyrantriol ].
^^Triple hyaluronic acid refers to the blend of Sodium hyaluronate and two molecular weight of Sodium Acetylated hyaluronate.
*Based on internal test data,comparing weight of tissue after absorption of serum versus weight of dry tissue, indicating the capacity of the tissue to absorb the serum.
